response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT corpeventprx, AVG(anlycount) AS avg_anlycount, AVG(inholdpct - instownpct) AS avg_diff FROM sentimentandfundamentals GROUP BY corpeventprx), o AS (SELECT AVG(avg_diff) AS overall_avg FROM g) SELECT g.corpeventprx AS event_type, g.avg_anlycount AS avg_analyst_count, g.avg_diff AS avg_insider_minus_institutional_pct, g.avg_diff - o.overall_avg AS diff_vs_overall_avg FROM g CROSS JOIN o WHERE o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL

assumptions.assumption: The row-level difference is inholdpct - instownpct. If either value is missing, that row's difference is missing and is ignored in the average. The anlycount average is calculated separately and ignores only missing anlycount values.

Snapshots with a NULL corpeventprx form one group, shown with a NULL event type. The overall average is the unweighted mean of the per-group average differences. Groups whose average difference is missing are left out of that mean, and those groups show a NULL comparison value.
